id: \bI wonder what this place looked like before the Darkest Day.
en: \bI wonder what this place looked like before the Darkest Day.
it: \bChissà com'era questo posto prima del Giorno più Buio.
\bIo? Mi sto solo godendo una nuotata.
\rDa queste parti ho catturato un Duraludon.

id: \rBringing a Kubfu here and interacting with the rocks will cause it to evolve. Which would you pick?
en: \rBringing a Kubfu here and interacting with the rocks will cause it to evolve. Which would you pick?
it: \rSe porti qui un Kubfu e interagisci con le rocce, si evolverà. Quale sceglieresti?

id: \bI used to live in Motostoke. Now I camp out here.
en: \bI used to live in Motostoke. Now I camp out here.
it: \bUna volta vivevo a Steamington. Adesso mi accampo qui.
